title: xDrip application stops receiving data
symptom: xDrip foreground services seems to stop, no data is received in xDrip. In Events log shows: Got exception trying to use Android 10+ service starting for DoNothingService java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: foregroundServiceType 0x00000008 is not a subset of foregroundServiceType attribute 0x00000000 in service element of manifest file.
cause: The exception can be fixed, easily. But I'm unsure whether this fixes the problem of not receiving data. IMHO, this bug occurred due to some Android security patches because nothing has changed with the xDrip code related to background services and/or communication with devices and other apps.
fix: Merge PR #1568 into your build and test whether it works.
evidence_quote: The exception can be fixed, easily. But I'm unsure whether this fixes the problem of not receiving data.
